Police Question Family of CJP's Saurav Das, CJP Alleges Intimidation

Puducherry police questioned the family of Saurav Das, a spokesperson for the Citizens for Justice and Peace (CJP). CJP alleged that the questioning was an attempt by the central government to intimidate them and that their efforts to deter the organization would fail. The outlets also noted that the BJP was accused of involvement. The specific reason provided by Puducherry police for the questioning was not detailed in the coverage.
